app.name: Spotule
app.tagline: Your Spotify control center & lifetime tracker.

auth.premiumRequired: Spotify Premium is required for playback control.

landing.title: Every stream. Every genre you never want to hear again.
landing.subtitle: Lifetime listening history beyond Spotify's 50-track limit, Stats.fm-style dashboards, a real-time genre ban-hammer and 100+ playlist tools — for you and your friends, each with a private library.

tracking.title: Tracking engine
tracking.body: Background logger + official data-export importer build an immutable history.

banhammer.title: Ban-Hammer
banhammer.body: Blacklist genres; purge your library; auto-skip within 500 ms.

tools.title: Playlist tools
tools.body: True shuffle, blender, splitter, sonic filters, bulk commander, porter.

friends.title: Friends
friends.body: Compare your listening with friends who opt in.

stats.title: Stats

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.empty: Add friends to compare your stats.

stats.empty: No listening data for this timeframe yet.

banhammer.title: Anti-Genre Ban-Hammer
banhammer.subtitle: Genres you ban here are removed from your library on demand and skipped instantly while playing.
banhammer.patternHint: e.g. rap, hip hop, trap — “contains” also catches “french rap”
banhammer.exemptionsHint: Artists, albums or tracks that are always allowed.

purge.title: Library purger
purge.subtitle: Scan Liked Songs or a playlist and remove every blacklisted track. A backup is taken first.

guard.title: Real-time skip guard
guard.subtitle: Watches your active device (phone, desktop, web) and skips blacklisted genres within 500 ms.

tools.title: Tools
tools.subtitle: Playlist compactor, utilities and automations.
tools.destructive: Modifies your library — a backup is taken first

imports.title: Import your lifetime history
imports.subtitle: Request “Extended streaming history” at spotify.com/account/privacy, then upload the ZIP here.
imports.drop: Drop the ZIP file or click to choose
imports.rows: {inserted, number} rows imported · {dupes, number} duplicates skipped

automations.title: Automations
automations.subtitle: Recurring jobs run by the worker on your schedule.

kinds.backup_discover_weekly: Back up Discover Weekly every Monday
kinds.backup_release_radar: Back up Release Radar every Friday
